blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate videos chunk by chunk, yet producing plausible continuations does not guarantee that they capture how scenes evolve. Under teacher forcing, strong temporal redundancy may allow local visual continuity to serve as a shortcut for current-chunk denoising, reducing the pressure to model visual evolution. We introduce Future Chunk Prediction (FCP), an auxiliary objective jointly optimized with teacher-forced denoising that predicts temporally separated chunks without access to the intervening visual context. Drawing supervision directly from training videos, FCP requires no additional pretrained visual encoder and leaves autoregressive inference unchanged. Our method achieves superior physical plausibility over standard teacher-forced autoregressive training with a lower overall training compute budget, highlighting the effectiveness and efficiency of future-chunk supervision for modeling visual evolution. Intriguingly, our visualizations suggest that FCP fosters a more structured representation space, which may be valuable for building autoregressive world models.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Autoregressive video generation ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ; Yuan et al., 2026 ) has emerged as an important direction in video generation, offering a flexible paradigm in which visual sequences can be extended continuously.
It typically operates through chunk-wise temporal rollout, where each new chunk is generated conditioned on preceding visual context.
As an important pathway toward generative world modeling ( Bruce et al., 2024 ; Valevski et al., 2025 ) , such a history-conditioned generator is expected not merely to produce plausible successive chunks, but also to model how visual scenes evolve over time.
blocks.zh:
自动回转视频生成(杨等,2025年;黄等,2025年;朱等,2026年;袁等,2026年)作为视频生成的重要方向出现,为视觉序列持续延伸提供了灵活模式.
它通常通过块状时间推展运行,每个新块的生成都以先前的视觉环境为条件.
作为遗传世界建模的重要途径(Bruce等人, 2024年;Valevski等人, 2025年),

blocks.en:
However, the ability to extend a video does not by itself guarantee that the model has learned how the scene should evolve.
We argue that a key reason is standard teacher forcing, where the current chunk is denoised given ground-truth history.
Due to the strong temporal redundancy in videos, neighboring chunks often share highly similar appearance and motion patterns.
As a result, the model may rely heavily on local visual continuity to recover the current chunk, creating a shortcut that provides limited pressure to capture the underlying dynamics of scene evolution.
blocks.zh:
然而,扩展视频的能力本身并不能保证模型已经学会了场景应如何演化.
我们提出,一个关键的原因是标准教师强迫,因为根据事实背景,目前这一块被抹杀。
由于视频中的时间冗余性很强,相邻块往往有着高度相似的外观和运动模式.
因此,该模型可能严重依赖局部视觉连续性来恢复当前块,创造了一条快捷键,为捕捉场景演化的基本动态提供了有限的压力.

blocks.en:
This motivates us to seek supervision that goes beyond what can be readily inferred from local visual continuity.
A natural place to look is farther into the future.
As the prediction target moves farther from the observed history, local appearance and motion continuity provide less direct support for recovering the target, thereby placing greater pressure on the model to capture temporal progression.
Importantly, this supervision comes directly from the training video itself, without requiring external pretrained representations or semantic alignment ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) .
blocks.zh:
这促使我们寻求超越从当地视觉连续性可以轻易推断出来的监督。
一个自然的地方去寻找 更远的未来。
随着预测目标离观测历史更远,局部外观和运动连续性为恢复目标提供了较少的直接支持,从而给模型带来更大的压力以捕捉时间进展.
重要的是,这种监督直接来自培训录像本身,不需要外部事先培训的表述或语义调整(Yu等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年a) 。 。 。

blocks.en:
Motivated by this intuition, we introduce Future Chunk Prediction (FCP), a simple auxiliary objective for autoregressive video diffusion training.
In addition to denoising the target chunk under standard teacher forcing, FCP uses the learned intermediate representation to predict a target beyond the current chunk, without exposing the model to the intervening ground-truth visual context.
This complementary objective places additional training pressure on the learned representations to capture information relevant to visual evolution, a capability fundamental to effective temporal rollout in autoregressive video generation.
Importantly, FCP is introduced only during training and leaves the original autoregressive inference process unchanged.
blocks.zh:
基于这种直觉,我们引入了Future Chunk Project(FCP),这是自动视频传播训练的一个简单的辅助目标.
FCP除了在标准教师强迫下去命名目标块之外,还利用学习到的中间代表来预测一个超越当前块的目标,而不会使模型暴露在介入的地面真实视觉上.
这一互补目标给学习到的表达带来了额外的培训压力,以获取与视觉演化有关的信息,而视觉演化能力对于自动视频生成中的有效时间推出至关重要。
重要的是,只有在培训期间才采用FCP,而原自动推论程序保持不变。

blocks.en:
To assess whether this additional supervision improves the modeling of visual evolution, we focus on physical plausibility as a concrete and challenging evaluation dimension.
Our method demonstrates improved physical plausibility over standard teacher-forced autoregressive training under matched data exposure and training budget, highlighting the effectiveness and efficiency of future-chunk supervision.
These results highlight the potential of exploiting richer predictive supervision from existing video data, rather than relying solely on increased training resources.
blocks.zh:
为了评估这种额外的监督是否改善了视觉进化的模型化,我们把物理可信度作为一个具体和具有挑战性的评价层面。
我们的方法表明,在相应的数据曝光和培训预算下,与标准的教师强制自动递解培训相比,实际可信度有所提高,突出了未来监管的有效性和效率。
这些结果突出了利用现有视频数据进行更丰富的预测监督的潜力,而不是仅仅依靠增加的培训资源。

blocks.en:
Beyond the improvements in generation quality, we further examine how FCP affects the intermediate video representations.
Interestingly, the introduced supervision induces more pronounced spatiotemporal organization in the representation space, suggesting that FCP also meaningfully reshapes the representations learned during training.
This finding highlights the potential of future prediction for learning representations better suited to autoregressive video generation, which may further benefit generative world modeling.
blocks.zh:
除了提高发电质量外,我们进一步审查FCP如何影响中间视频显示。
有趣的是,引入的监督在代表空间中诱发了更明显的时空组织,这表明FCP也有意义地重塑了在培训期间学到的表述.
这一结论凸显了今后预测学习表现方式更适合自动视频生成的潜力,这可能会进一步有利于基因世界模型的制作。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Autoregressive Video Diffusion
blocks.zh: 2.1 自动视频扩散

blocks.en:
Conventional video diffusion models typically synthesize fixed-duration clips in a single denoising process ( Ho et al., 2022 ; Blattmann et al., 2023 ; Team, 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) .
Autoregressive video diffusion instead extends video chunk by chunk, conditioning on preceding visual context ( Voleti et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Teng et al., 2025 ) .
This formulation supports streaming generation and provides a basis for interactive visual simulation and generative world modeling ( Bruce et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Valevski et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
常规视频传播模型通常在一个单一的去诺化过程中合成固定期限剪辑(Ho等人,2022年;Blatmann等人,2023年;Team,2025年;Wang等人,2025年a).
自动递归式视频传播方式将视频块逐块扩展,以先前的视觉环境为条件(Voleti等人,第19段)。 2022; Chen等人, 2024; Teng等人, 2025).
这种配方支持流体生成,并为交互式视觉模拟和基因世界模型化提供了基础(Bruce等人,2024年;He等人,2025年;Yang等人,2025年;Valevski等人,2025年)。

blocks.en:
Prior work addresses rollout quality by adapting bidirectional models into causal few-step generators through distribution matching or adversarial training ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2025 ) , exposing models to self-generated histories or extended student rollouts ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Cui et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) , and examining the causal compatibility of teacher supervision with student generation ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) .
Other approaches manage historical context through active windows, cached states, or global anchors ( Gao et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) , while selective retrieval and cache compression balance long-range consistency against computational and memory costs ( Cai et al., 2025 ; Samuel et al., 2026 ; Ji et al., 2026 ) .
Our approach complements these directions by adding future-chunk supervision to teacher-forced training without prescribing rollout distillation or inference-time context management.
blocks.zh:
前期工作通过配送配对或对抗训练,将双向模式调整为因果的几步生成器(Yin等人,2025年;Lin等人,2025年),使模式暴露于自创历史或扩展的学生推出(Huang等人,2025年;Cui等人,2025年;Liu等人,2025年),并审查教师监管与学生一代的因果兼容性(Zhu等人,2026年;Zheng等人,2026年)。
其他方法通过活动窗口,缓存状态,或全球锚地来管理历史背景(Gao等人,2025年;Yang等人,2025年;Liu等人,2025年),而选择性检索和缓存压缩平衡长距离一致性与计算和内存成本(Cai等人,2025年;Samuel等人,2026年;Ji等人,2026年).
我们的方法补充了这些方向,在师资培训中增加了未来的监督,而没有规定推展蒸馏或推论时间背景管理。

blocks.en: 2.2 Representation Alignment for Generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 世代代表制

blocks.en:
Aligning intermediate diffusion features with vision foundation models can accelerate training and improve generation quality ( Yu et al., 2025 ) .
Video extensions use cross-frame and multi-feature alignment ( Hwang et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) , or relational supervision targeting physical plausibility ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) .
These methods rely on targets from external pretrained encoders ( Oquab et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) , which may complicate scaling to large video corpora.
Our approach instead derives supervision from future chunks in the training videos, without an additional pretrained vision model, offering a data-native path toward scaling.
blocks.zh:
将中间传播特征与视觉基础模型相结合,可以加快培训,提高生成质量(Yu等人,2025年)。
视频扩展使用跨帧和多地貌对齐(Hwang等人,2025年;Lee等人,2025年),或针对物理可信度的关系监督(Zhang等人,2025年a).
这些方法依赖于来自外部预训编码器(Oquab等人,2024年;Wang等人,2023年)的目标,这可能会使缩放到大型视频公司更加复杂.
相反,我们的方法来自培训录像中的未来片段,没有经过预先培训的视觉模型,为扩大规模提供了一条数据本土路径。

blocks.en: Our work was developed independently of and concurrently with Next Forcing ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , the closest related approach. We include relevant comparisons in our experiments and provide a more detailed discussion in the appendix.

blocks.en: 3.2 Autoregressive Video Generation
blocks.zh: 3.2 自动回归视频生成

blocks.en:
Autoregressive video generation, also referred to as streaming video generation, generates videos through chunk-wise temporal rollout ( Yin et al., 2025 ) .
In diffusion-based instantiations, each autoregressive step generates a multi-frame chunk conditioned on the preceding observed or generated context.
Repeatedly applying a fixed-length chunk generator supports long-form video generation over a flexible number of chunks.
This chunk-wise formulation is distinct from discrete-token autoregressive video generation ( Hong et al., 2023 ; Yu et al., 2024 ; Kondratyuk et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) , which sequentially predicts tokenized representations, and from single-shot generation, which produces a fixed-length clip in one invocation.

blocks.en: 4.1 Future Chunk Prediction
blocks.zh: 4.1 未来春克预测

blocks.en:
Building upon the teacher-forced formulation in Section 3.3 , each target chunk is denoised conditioned on its temporally contiguous ground-truth history.
As discussed in Section 1 , the strong temporal redundancy of video allows this immediately preceding correct context to provide substantial support for current-chunk denoising, reducing the pressure to capture temporal progression and potentially hindering the learning of representations that capture visual evolution.
This observation suggests a simple design principle: we seek a learning signal that is less directly supported by such immediately preceding context, yet remains intrinsic to the training video itself, allowing the supervision to scale naturally with video data without relying on external pretrained representations.
blocks.zh:
根据3.3节中教师强制的表述,每个目标块都以时间上毗连的地面真实历史为条件。
正如第1节所讨论的,视频的强烈时间冗余使得紧接着正确的上下文能够为当前充电的调值提供大量支持,减少捕捉时间进展的压力,并可能阻碍对捕捉视觉进化的表达的学习.
这个观察建议了一个简单的设计原则:我们寻求一个学习信号,这个信号不那么直接地受到这种紧接前文的背景支持,然而它仍然是训练视频本身的内在内容,使得监督可以自然地用视频数据进行规模化,而无需依赖外部事先训练过的表示.

blocks.en:
To this end, we introduce Future Chunk Prediction (FCP), which supplements next-chunk denoising with an auxiliary task of predicting temporally more distant chunks from the same video.
By excluding the intervening chunks from the visual context, this task discourages reliance on local temporal continuity and encourages stronger predictive representations of visual evolution.
blocks.zh:
为此,我们推出未来春克预测(FCP),它补充了下一春克的调试,并附带一项任务,即从同一个视频中预测时间上更遥远的块.
通过将中间的块排除在视觉环境之外,这项任务阻止了对局部时间连续性的依赖,并鼓励对视觉进化作出更强的预测。

blocks.en:
Formally, re-indexing a factor in equation 3 , standard next-chunk prediction given the observed prefix 𝐱 ≤ k \mathbf{x}_{\leq k} models p ⁡ ( 𝐱 k + 1 ∣ 𝐱 ≤ k , 𝐜 ) . p(\mathbf{x}_{k+1}\mid\mathbf{x}_{\leq k},\mathbf{c}). FCP instead requires the same available context to support prediction of a farther target: p FCP ​ ( 𝐱 k + Δ ∣ 𝐱 ≤ k , 𝐜 ) , Δ > 1 , k + Δ ≤ K , p_{\mathrm{FCP}}(\mathbf{x}_{k+\Delta}\mid\mathbf{x}_{\leq k},\mathbf{c}),\qquad\Delta>1,\quad k+\Delta\leq K, (5) where Δ \Delta is an integer temporal offset measured in chunks.
In this formulation, the intervening chunks 𝐱 k + 1 : k + Δ − 1 \mathbf{x}_{k+1:k+\Delta-1} are excluded from the conditioning context, yielding a supervisory signal that is distinct from and complementary to standard teacher forcing.
blocks.zh:
形式上,在方程式3中重新索引一个因子,标准下个中位值的预测,考虑到观测到的前缀 x k\\ mathbf{ x}_{\leq k}模型 p⁡(x k + 1∣ x≤ k, c). p (\ mathbf{ x}_{k+ 1}\ mid\ mathb{ x}_{\leq k},\mathbf{ c}). 相反,为了支持对更远的目标的预测,FCP需要同样的现有上下文:pFCP(x k + + + + + + → k, c ),Δ > 1,k + + → K, p_{\ mathrm{FCP}} (\ mathbf{x}}} 德尔塔{mid\ mathbf{x}},\ mathbf{ c},\qquad\ Delta > 1,\quad kQQQDelta\leq K, (5) 其中 QQ\Delta 是用块测量的整数时间抵消 。
在这个公式中,中间块x k + 1: k + — 1\ mathbf{x}_{k+1:k+\ Delta-1)被排除在条件上下文之外,产生一种不同于标准教师强迫的监管信号,并与之互补.

blocks.en:
A natural implementation of FCP uses an auxiliary predictor with dedicated parameters.
In preliminary experiments, sharing generator parameters between teacher-forced denoising and masked-context future prediction degraded temporal coherence, possibly because the two objectives place competing demands on shared parameters.
blocks.zh:
FCP的自然执行使用带有专用参数的辅助预测器.
在初步实验中,在教师强迫的去诺和掩盖的将来预测之间共享生成参数,可能是因为这两个目标对共享参数提出了相互竞争的要求。

blocks.en:
However, training this predictor in isolation would leave the main generator unaffected.
We therefore condition the predictor on the generator’s intermediate hidden states and backpropagate the auxiliary loss through them ( DeepSeek-AI, 2024 ) .
This design regularizes these representations to capture visual evolution and better support autoregressive rollout.
blocks.zh:
然而,孤立地培训这一预测器将使主要发电机不受影响。
因此,我们将预测器附加在发电机的中间隐藏状态上,并背对通过这些状态的辅助损失(Deep Seek-AI,2024年)。
这种设计使这些表示规范化,以捕捉视觉进化,更好地支持自转式推出.

blocks.en:
For a practical realization of the above formulation, let 𝐡 k \mathbf{h}_{k} denote the generator’s intermediate hidden states corresponding to chunk k k .
The auxiliary prediction is then expressed as p FCP ​ ( 𝐱 k + Δ ∣ 𝐡 k ) , Δ ≥ 1 . p_{\mathrm{FCP}}\!\left(\mathbf{x}_{k+\Delta}\mid\mathbf{h}_{k}\right),\qquad\Delta\geq 1. (6)

Compared with equation 5 , this formulation incorporates two deliberate choices regarding the conditioning information.
First, we omit explicit text conditioning, encouraging the auxiliary predictor to derive predictive information from 𝐡 k \mathbf{h}_{k} rather than a separate textual input.
Second, we condition the auxiliary predictor on 𝐡 k \mathbf{h}_{k} rather than 𝐡 ≤ k \mathbf{h}_{\leq k} , encouraging a more compact encoding of predictive information while reducing computational cost.
We examine the effects of these conditioning choices through ablation studies in Section 5 .
blocks.zh:
与方程式5相比,这一提法包含了关于条件信息的两个深思熟虑的选择。
首先,我们省略了明确的文本条件,鼓励辅助预测器从h k\ mathbf{h}_{k}中获取预测信息,而不是单独的文本输入.
第二,我们以 h k\ mathbf{ h}_{k} 而不是 h\ k\ mathbf{ h}_{\leq k} 为辅助预测器设条件,鼓励对预测信息进行更紧凑的编码,同时降低计算成本.
我们通过第5节的消化研究来研究这些条件选择的效果。

blocks.en: 4.2 FCP Architecture
blocks.zh: 4.2 财务程序 建筑

blocks.en:
Building on the formulation in equation 6 , we present one concrete implementation of FCP to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
For the autoregressive generator, we use a standard video diffusion model ( Wang et al., 2025a ) whose backbone consists of stacked diffusion transformer (DiT) blocks with chunk-causal attention.
The auxiliary predictor adopts a lightweight counterpart of this DiT architecture with a separate set of parameters.
Figure 1 illustrates the overall architecture, with component-specific designs described below.
blocks.zh:
在方程式6的提法的基础上,我们提出一个具体执行“财务程序”的方法,以评估拟议方法的有效性。
对于自递式发电机,我们使用一种标准的视频传播模型(Wang et al.,2025a),其骨干由堆叠式扩散变压器(DIT)块组成,有块-原因的注意.
辅助预测器采用了这个DiT架构的轻量级对应器,并有一套单独的参数.
图1说明了总体结构,具体组成部分的设计说明如下。

blocks.en:
We extract intermediate features associated with chunk k k in both clean and noise-perturbed states, denoted by 𝐡 k clean \mathbf{h}_{k}^{\mathrm{clean}} and 𝐡 k noisy \mathbf{h}_{k}^{\mathrm{noisy}} , respectively.
Clean context provides historical information for subsequent chunk generation, while the noisy target is progressively denoised to produce the current chunk.
We consider both roles essential to autoregressive generation and therefore regularize both types of representations through future-prediction supervision.
blocks.zh:
我们从干净状态和噪音扰动状态中提取与块 k k 相关的中间特征, 分别以 h k clean\ mathbf{ h}_{k}^{\mathrm{ clean}} 和 h k k cloudy\ mathbf{ h}_{k}^{\k}^{\mathrm{noisy}} 表示.
干净的上下文为随后的块生成提供了历史信息,而吵闹的目标则逐渐去除,以产生当前块.
我们认为,这两种作用对于自动生成至关重要,因此,通过未来预测监督,使这两种表述方式正规化。

blocks.en:
Each future offset has a separate predictor conditioned directly on 𝐡 k \mathbf{h}_{k} , rather than on hidden states from preceding predictors ( DeepSeek-AI, 2024 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) .
In the chained design (Figure 2(a) ), information from the noisy input for f t + 2 f_{t+2} can reach the predictor for f t + 3 f_{t+3} along the red path.
Given video’s temporal redundancy, this may create a shortcut that weakens the pressure on the source representation to encode future evolution.
Our parallel design (Figure 2(b) ) removes inter-offset information flow, preventing this particular shortcut.
Its independent branches could also run concurrently across GPUs or be flexibly loaded and unloaded during training.
blocks.zh:
每个未来抵消有一个单独的预测器,直接以h k\ mathbf{h}_{k}作为条件,而不是以先前预测器的隐藏状态作为条件(Deep Seek-AI, 2024;徐等人, 2026).
在链式设计(图2(a))中,ft + 2 f_{t+2}的噪音输入信息可以沿着红色路径到达ft + 3 f_{t+3}的预测器.
鉴于视频的时间冗余,这可能会产生一种快捷方式,削弱源表达的压力,以编码未来的演化.
我们的平行设计(图2(b))消除了相互抵消的信息流,阻止了这个特定的快捷键.
其独立分支也可同时运行于GPU之间,或在训练期间灵活装卸.

blocks.en: (a) Chained prediction: information from noisy intermediate targets may leak to subsequent predictors along the red arrows.
blocks.zh: (a) 连锁预测:来自吵闹的中间目标的信息可能泄露给红箭沿线随后的预测器。

blocks.en: (b) Parallel prediction: offset-specific predictors can run concurrently across GPUs and be flexibly enabled or disabled during training.
blocks.zh: (b) 平行预测:特定抵消预测器可同时运行在一般股之间,在培训期间可灵活启用或停用。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Two variants of future-prediction supervision, illustrated through the green paths from 𝐡 t \mathbf{h}_{t} to f t + 3 f_{t+3} . The chained design passes hidden states between predictors, whereas the parallel design conditions each predictor directly on the source representations.
blocks.zh: 图2:未来预测监管的两个变体,通过h t\ mathbf{h}_{t}到f t + 3 f_{t+3}的绿色路径来说明. 连锁设计通过预测器之间的隐藏状态,而每个预测器直接在源表示上平行的设计条件.

blocks.en:
To capture information at different semantic levels, we extract features from multiple generator layers, concatenate them along the channel dimension at corresponding token positions, and fuse them with an MLP.
Inspired by prior AdaLN-based conditioning designs ( Wang et al., 2026b ; Pan et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) , we inject the fused features into every auxiliary DiT block through token-wise AdaLN modulation, preserving fine-grained conditioning across spatiotemporal positions.
blocks.zh:
为了捕捉不同语义层面的信息,我们从多个生成层中提取特征,在相应的符号位置沿通道维度将其凝聚,并用MLP将其熔化.
受以前基于AdaLN的空调设计(Wang等人,2026年b;Pan等人,2026年a;Wang等人,2026年a)的启发,我们通过象征性的AdaLN调制,将引信的特性注入每个辅助DiT区块,在整个spatiental位置上保持精细的加固调节.

blocks.en:
Unlike the text-conditioned main generator, the auxiliary predictors omit text cross-attention from every DiT block.
Consistent with equation 6 , this asymmetry blocks a direct pathway through which text prompts could leak cues about future events, encouraging the predictors to rely on the generator’s source representations instead.
This design also reduces the predictors’ parameter count and computational cost.
blocks.zh:
与文本条件主生成器不同,辅助预测器在每一个DiT块中省略了文本的交叉注意.
与方程式6一致的是,这种不对称会堵塞一条直接路径,通过这条路径,文字提示会泄露未来事件的线索,鼓励预测者依赖生成器的源表示。
这种设计还降低了预测器的参数计数和计算成本.

blocks.en: 4.3 Training and Inference
blocks.zh: 4.3 培训和推论

blocks.en:
We jointly optimize the autoregressive generator and auxiliary predictors using flow matching.
For each offset Δ \Delta in a predefined set 𝒟 \mathcal{D} , a separate auxiliary predictor follows the flow-matching objective in Section 3.1 , conditioned on either clean or noisy source representations.
Target noise and flow time are resampled for each auxiliary prediction.
Let ℒ Δ clean \mathcal{L}_{\Delta}^{\mathrm{clean}} and ℒ Δ noisy \mathcal{L}_{\Delta}^{\mathrm{noisy}} denote the corresponding losses, each averaged over all valid supervision pairs ( k , k + Δ ) (k,k+\Delta) satisfying k + Δ ≤ K k+\Delta\leq K .
The resulting joint objective takes the form: ℒ total = ℒ TF + ∑ Δ ∈ 𝒟 w Δ ​ ℒ Δ clean + ℒ Δ noisy 2 . \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{total}}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{TF}}+\sum_{\Delta\in\mathcal{D}}w_{\Delta}\frac{\mathcal{L}_{\Delta}^{\mathrm{clean}}+\mathcal{L}_{\Delta}^{\mathrm{noisy}}}{2}. (7) Here, w Δ w_{\Delta} controls the contribution of each offset.
Clean and noisy source representations share the predictor for a given offset, and the auxiliary losses backpropagate through these representations into the generator.

blocks.en:
At inference, we discard all FCP-specific modules, retaining the same autoregressive generator and rollout procedure as the teacher-forcing baseline without additional overhead.
Qualitative visualizations of the auxiliary predictors suggest that they capture plausible future evolution despite limited visual fidelity.
We leave their potential use for sampling acceleration through early-stage denoising or generation enhancement through prediction ensembling to future work.
blocks.zh:
推论,我们放弃所有FCP特定模块,保留与教师强制基准相同的自动递归发生器和推出程序,而无需增加间接费用。
辅助预测器的定性可视化表明,尽管视觉上的忠诚程度有限,它们仍能捕捉到可能的未来演变。
我们通过早期去诺或通过对未来工作的预测增强生成,将其用于取样加速。

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 5.1 执行细节

blocks.en:
We initialize our autoregressive generators from official Wan checkpoints ( Wang et al., 2025a ) .
For our implementation, we choose the image-to-video setting, treating the initial frame as fixed clean context and generating subsequent chunks of three latent frames.
Each auxiliary predictor contains three DiT blocks initialized from the corresponding generator; the generators and predictors are then jointly optimized.
Further model and training details are provided in Appendix A .
blocks.zh:
(Wang等人,2025年a) 。 。 。
为了执行,我们选择图像到视频的设定,将初始框架视为固定的清洁上下文,并产生三个潜在框架的后续块。
每个辅助预测器包含从相应的生成器初始化的三个DiT区块;然后发电机和预测器被联合优化.
附录A提供了进一步的模型和培训细节。

blocks.en: 5.2 Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 5.2 基准

blocks.en:
Modeling visual evolution involves diverse aspects of temporal dynamics, making its comprehensive evaluation an open challenge ( Li et al., 2025b ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) .
In this work, we focus primarily on physical plausibility ( Brooks et al., 2024 ; Kang et al., 2025 ; Agarwal et al., 2025 ) , motivated by the availability of dedicated benchmarks and systematic research on its evaluation.
This choice is further motivated by the role of physical plausibility in shaping the perceived realism of generated videos.
We adopt Physics-IQ Verified ( Rädsch et al., 2026 ) as our primary benchmark because its reference-based numerical metrics assess generated continuations against real-world recordings without relying on VLM-based judgments.
We further evaluate on WorldModelBench ( Li et al., 2025a ) , PAI-Bench-G ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) , and PhyGround ( Lin et al., 2026 ) as complementary physics-related benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
模拟视觉演化涉及时间动态的不同方面,使其综合评价成为公开挑战(Li等人,2025b;Ma等人,2026;Wu等人,2026).
在这项工作中,我们主要侧重于物理可信性(Brooks等人,2024年;Kang等人,2025年;Agarwal等人,2025年),其动机是提供专门的基准,并对其评价进行系统研究。
这一选择的动力进一步来自物理上在塑造所生成的视频的感知现实主义中的作用.
我们采用Physics-IQ验证法(Rädsch等人,2026年)作为我们的首要基准,因为其基于参考的数值测量法在不依赖基于VLM的判断的情况下,对照现实世界的录音来评估产生的续作.
我们进一步评价了WorldModel Bench(Li等人,2025年a),PAI-Bench-G(周等人,2025年)和PhyGround(Lin等人,2026年)作为与物理有关的补充基准。

blocks.en: 5.3 Datasets
blocks.zh: 5.3 数据集

blocks.en:
We train our models on a mixture of internally sourced videos and WISA-80K ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , using the original text annotations from each source.
The training data primarily comprises general-purpose real-world videos, without using data from physics simulators.
We select videos longer than five seconds and use approximately the first five seconds, sampled at the default frame rate of the corresponding model.
Incorporating physics-simulator data ( Aditi et al., 2026 ) may further improve physical plausibility as training scales, but we leave this possibility to future work.

培训数据主要包括通用现实世界视频,而不使用物理模拟器的数据。
我们选择超过5秒的视频,大约使用前5秒,以相应的模型的默认帧率进行抽样.
纳入物理模拟数据(Aditi等人,2026年)可进一步提高作为培训尺度的物理可信度,但我们将这一可能性留给今后的工作。

Differences in training data and settings limit the attribution of cross-model performance gaps to methodological improvements.
We therefore place greater emphasis on the controlled comparisons in Tables 2 and 4 , where matched data and experimental settings enable a fairer assessment.
Compared with teacher forcing, FCP raises the IQ score from 27.6 to 30.9 for the 1.3B model.
For the 5B model, it improves I2V and V2V scores from 30.4 to 33.8 and from 40.6 to 44.4, respectively.
These consistent gains support the effectiveness of future-prediction supervision in improving physical plausibility across scales and conditioning settings.

Figure 3 complements the quantitative results with two examples of temporal evolution.
FCP preserves the direction of domino toppling and captures the water-level rise visible in the ice-melting sequence, whereas the teacher-forcing baseline exhibits an anomalous central collapse in the former and misses the subtle level change in the latter.
Together, these examples suggest that FCP better captures physically plausible visual evolution, which is central to the perceived realism of generated videos.

这些例子共同表明FCP能更好地捕捉到物理上可行的视觉进化,而视觉进化对于所生成的视频的感知现实主义至关重要.

blocks.en:
We further evaluate on physics-related benchmarks, including WorldModelBench ( Li et al., 2025a ) , PAI-Bench-G ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) , and PhyGround ( Lin et al., 2026 ) .
As shown in Table 3 , FCP generally outperforms teacher forcing under matched settings, supporting the generalizability of our approach.
These evaluations rely on VLM-based judgments of specified criteria, which may be less sensitive to subtle differences in the timing and magnitude of physical changes than direct comparison with real-world reference videos.
This limited sensitivity may partly explain the modest gains on some metrics.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步评价与物理学有关的基准,包括WorldModel Bench(李等人,2025年a),PAI-Bench-G(周等人,2025年)和PhyGround(林等人,2026年)。
如表3所示,FCP一般在匹配的环境下强于教师,支持我们方法的普遍性。
这些评价依赖于基于VLM的对特定标准的判断,这些判断与直接比较现实世界参考视频相比,对物理变化的时间和规模的细微差异可能不太敏感.
这种有限的敏感性可能部分地解释了在某些衡量标准上进展不大的原因。

blocks.en: 5.5 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 5.5 阅读研究

blocks.en: Table 4: Ablation of the main FCP design components. The shaded row and column mark the default setting and overall IQ score, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表4:FCP主要设计部件的偏差. 阴影行和列分别标注默认设置和整体智商分数.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Training convergence on Physics-IQ Verified versus estimated training compute.
blocks.zh: 图4:经核实的物理-IQ培训与估计培训的趋同计算。

blocks.en: We primarily conduct ablation studies on Wan2.1-1.3B under identical settings across variants; detailed settings and results are provided in Appendices A.2 and B.1 , respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们主要在各种变体的相同设置下对Wan2.1-1.3B进行消化研究;附录A.2和B.1分别提供了详细的设置和结果。

blocks.en:
While prior representation-alignment methods ( Yu et al., 2025 ) primarily regularize intermediate features along the denoising process, clean historical context in autoregressive video generation also serves a predictive role, carrying information from the immediate past to support anticipation of future visual evolution.
Results in Table 4 support this view: regularizing clean-context or noisy-target representations improves IQ over teacher forcing by 1.2 and 2.3 points, respectively, while their combination yields a 3.3-point gain.
blocks.zh:
先前的表示-调和方法(Yu等人,2025年)主要沿消音过程使中间特征规范化,而自递录影带生成的清洁历史背景也起到预测作用,承载来自近期的信息以支持对未来视觉演化的预期.
表4中的结果支持这一观点:将 " 干净的文字 " 或 " 吵闹的目标表述 " 正规化,使 " 智商 " 分别比教师 " 强迫 " 提高1.2和2.3分,而两者的结合则产生3.3分的收益。

blocks.en:
Chained prediction provides a natural alternative ( DeepSeek-AI, 2024 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) to our parallel design; however, as illustrated in Figure 2(a) , it may exploit intermediate future information as a shortcut.
Consistent with this concern, Table 4 shows that parallel prediction improves the IQ score by 0.8, from 30.1 to 30.9.
The limitation of chained prediction is more pronounced in the controlled 5B comparison in Table 2 : the two chained variants (3 and 5 offsets) yield only marginal IQ-score gains over teacher forcing on I2V and fail to improve V2V performance.
This larger degradation may arise because the higher-capacity model can more readily exploit the potential leakage of intermediate future information illustrated in Figure 2(a) .
Together, these results show that our parallel design consistently outperforms the chained alternative across model scales and conditioning settings.
It also supports nonconsecutive future offsets, as evaluated in row (f) of Table 2 , through the independent branches shown in Figure 2(b) .
blocks.zh:
链式预测为我们平行设计提供了一个自然的替代品(DeepSeek-AI, 2024;徐等人, 2026);然而,如图2(a)所示,它可能利用中期未来信息作为捷径。
根据这种关切,表4显示平行预测将智商分数提高0.8,从30.1提高到30.9。
在表2的控制5B比较中,链式预测的局限性更为明显:两个链式变体(3和5抵消)仅产生边际智商分数收益,而不是教师强迫I2V,未能改善V2V性能.
这种较大的退化可能是由于能力较强的模型可以更方便地利用图2(a)所示未来中期信息的潜在泄漏。
这些结果表明,我们的平行设计在模型尺度和条件设置上一直比连锁替代方案要好。
它还通过图2(b)所示的独立分支支持表2(f)行所评价的非连续未来抵消。

blocks.en:
The closely related approach Next Forcing ( Xu et al., 2026 ) conditions future prediction on the full historical representations 𝐡 ≤ k \mathbf{h}_{\leq k} , motivating a full-context FCP variant for comparison.
Figure 4 compares teacher forcing, this full-context variant, and our default configuration.
Compared with standard teacher forcing, our configuration achieves higher IQ scores at comparable estimated training compute, indicating that its gains do not arise simply from additional computation.
Furthermore, our configuration is estimated to require 42.6% and 50.7% less training compute than the full-context variant to reach the same IQ scores of 29 and 30, respectively.
These results indicate that extending the conditioning context from 𝐡 k \mathbf{h}_{k} to 𝐡 ≤ k \mathbf{h}_{\leq k} provides no additional benefit for modeling video evolution, while the lower computational cost of 𝐡 k \mathbf{h}_{k} makes our formulation better suited to scaling autoregressive video models.
blocks.zh:
密切关联的方法Next Forcing(徐等人,2026年)为未来对完整历史表述的预测 h → k\ mathbf{h}_{\leq k} 提供了条件,激发了一个完整的FCP变体进行比较.
图4比较了老师的强迫,这个完整文本的变体,以及我们的默认配置.
与标准师力相比,我们的配置在可比估计的训练计算中实现了更高的智商分数,表明其收益并非仅仅来自于额外的计算.
此外,我们的配置估计需要42.6%和50.7%的培训计算比全文变量少,才能分别达到相同的智商分数29和30。
这些结果表明,将调制上下文从 h k\ mathbf{ h}_{k} 延伸至 h≤ k\ mathbf{ h}_{\leq k} 并不为建模视频演化提供额外好处, 而h k\ mathbf{ h}_{k} 较低的计算成本则使我们的配方更适合缩放自转视频模型.

blocks.en:
Comparing rows (d) and (e) in Table 4 , adding explicit text conditioning to the auxiliary predictors reduces the IQ score by 1.1.
This supports withholding text from future predictors, as direct textual cues may reveal future evolution and weaken their reliance on visual representations.
blocks.zh:
比较表4的(d)和(e)行,在辅助预测器中增加明确的文字条件,使智商分数减少1.1。
这支持从未来的预测器中预留文本,因为直接的文本提示可能揭示未来的演化,削弱其对视觉表达的依赖.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Spatial Feature Similarity Maps. Each map shows within-frame similarity to a selected query token. The top and bottom rows correspond to teacher forcing and FCP, respectively.
blocks.zh: 图5:空间特征相似性 地图. 每张地图都显示框架内与选定的查询符相似。 上下行分别对应老师强迫和FCP.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Spatiotemporal Feature Similarity Maps. The top row shows video frames, while the bottom row visualizes similarity to a selected query token across space and time.
blocks.zh: 图6: Spatiotempal 特性相似性 地图. 上行显示视频帧,而下行可视化到一个跨时空的选定查询符.

blocks.en: 5.6 Representation Space Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.6 代表空间分析

blocks.en:
Beyond physical-plausibility evaluation, we visualize the generator’s intermediate representations using query-to-token similarity maps.
As shown in Figure 5 , teacher forcing produces diffuse responses extending into unrelated regions, whereas FCP yields more selective responses aligned with the queried object and visually related instances.
Figure 6 further shows that high-similarity regions remain aligned with corresponding content as it moves across frames.
Together, these visualizations suggest that FCP-trained representations capture clearer spatial structure and meaningful temporal correspondence.
We believe that such semantically structured representations may provide a useful foundation for future world models.
blocks.zh:
除了物理可信度评价之外,我们用查询到磁盘的相似性图来视觉化生成器的中间表示。
如图5所示,教师强迫产生分散的反应,扩展到无关地区,而FCP则产生与被询问对象和视觉相关情况相一致的更具选择性的反应。
图6还显示,高度相似区域在跨框架移动时仍然与相应内容保持一致。
这些可视化合在一起表明,FCP训练的表达方式能够捕捉更清晰的空间结构和有意义的时间对应.
我们认为,这种有条理的表述可能为今后的世界模式提供有益的基础。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced Future Chunk Prediction (FCP), an auxiliary objective that predicts temporally separated chunks from the same training video in autoregressive video diffusion.
Optimized jointly with the standard teacher-forced denoising objective, FCP provides complementary supervision to the generator’s intermediate representations without requiring an additional pretrained encoder.
The auxiliary predictors are removed at inference, leaving the autoregressive generation process unchanged.
Controlled comparisons show improved physical plausibility across model scales and conditioning settings.
More surprisingly, our visualizations suggest that FCP also induces a more structured representation space, which we believe may be important for autoregressive world models.
Together, these findings support future prediction as a promising training principle for autoregressive video generation.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了Future Chunk Project(FCP),这是一个辅助目标,在自动视频传播中从同一个训练视频中预测在时间上分开的块.
FCP与标准的教师强制解密目标共同优化,为发电机的中间表示提供补充监督,而不需要额外经过预先培训的编码器。
辅助预测器在推论时被移除,使得自递性生成过程保持不变.
受控比较显示,模型尺度和条件设置的物理可信度有所提高。
更令人惊讶的是,我们的可视化表明,FCP还诱导了一个更有条理的表示空间,我们认为,对于自转性的世界模型来说,这可能是重要的.
这些调查结果共同支持未来的预测,认为是自动录影带生成的有希望的培训原则。

blocks.en: Reproducibility Statement
blocks.zh: 可复制声明

blocks.en:
Sections 4 and 5 describe our method, training setup, datasets, and evaluation protocols, with further implementation details in Appendix A .
Our code is available at https://github.com/TencentARC/Looking-Ahead ; model checkpoints are not included in this source package.
For the public portion of our training data, we will provide source links and selection criteria; we will also provide representative examples of the internally sourced data.
The complete internal corpus cannot be released, so exact reproduction of training with identical data may not be possible; nevertheless, we will make every effort to support reproducibility.

第4节和第5节介绍了我们的方法、培训设置、数据集和评价协议,附录A载有进一步的实施细节。
我们的代码见https://github.com/TencentARC/Looking-Ahead。 样板检查站不包括在这个源包中。

blocks.en: Appendix A Additional Experimental Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 其他实验细节

blocks.en: A.1 Model Configurations
blocks.zh: A.1 模型配置

blocks.en:
We initialize the generators from the official Wan ( Wang et al., 2025a ) checkpoints listed in Table 5 .
For all checkpoints, we implement image-to-video generation by keeping the initial image’s latent representation as fixed clean context and generating only subsequent chunks.
Source features are extracted from the outputs of four selected DiT blocks and concatenated at corresponding token positions.
A two-layer MLP with dimensions 4 ​ d → 2 ​ d → d 4d\rightarrow 2d\rightarrow d and a GELU activation fuses these features, where d d is the backbone hidden dimension.
Each future offset has an independently parameterized auxiliary branch, including its fusion MLP, patch embedding, DiT blocks, and output head.
Within each offset, all these parameters are shared between the clean and noisy source pathways.
Auxiliary DiT blocks inherit the hidden and FFN dimensions of the corresponding backbone and are initialized from the layers specified in Table 5 .
All layer indices are one-based.
blocks.zh:
我们从表5所列的官方Wan(Wang等人,2025a)检查站启动发电机。
对所有检查站来说,我们实施图像到视频生成,将初始图像的潜在表现作为固定的清洁背景,只产生随后的块。
从4个选定的DiT区块的输出中提取出源特性,并在相应的符号位置进行调制.
双层MLP的维度为4 d → 2 d → 4d\直径为2d\直径的D 和GELU的激活引信,其中dd是主干部分隐藏的维度.
每个未来偏移都有一个独立的参数化辅助分支,包括它的聚变MLP,补丁嵌入,DiT块,以及输出头.
在每个抵消范围内,所有这些参数都由干净和吵闹的来源路径共享。
辅助DiT块继承了对应主干线的隐藏和FFN维度,并从表5指定的层中初始化.
所有层指数都是单基的.

blocks.en: Table 5: Model configurations. All layer indices are one-based. Hidden and FFN dimensions apply to both the backbone and its auxiliary DiT blocks.
blocks.zh: 表5:模型配置. 所有层指数都是单基的. 隐藏和FFN维度既适用于骨干区块,也适用于其辅助的DiT区块.

blocks.en:
The 1.3B and 5B configurations may appear to follow different design principles.
These differences arise from choices made at different stages of development.
blocks.zh:
1.3B和5B配置可能看起来遵循不同的设计原则.
这些差异产生于在不同发展阶段作出的选择。

blocks.en:
For source-layer selection, the 1.3B configuration evolved from an early single-layer variant using layer 15, subsequently expanded to include both shallower and deeper features.
For the 5B model, we select approximately evenly spaced layers backward from the final block to provide direct auxiliary supervision across the generator’s depth, while excluding the earliest blocks whose features may not yet be sufficiently semantically informative.
Computational constraints have prevented a systematic comparison of these source-layer selection strategies, which we may revisit in future scaling efforts.
blocks.zh:
对于源层选择,1.3B配置由早期使用第15层的单层变体演化而来,后来被扩展为包括更浅和更深的特征.
对于5B模型,我们从最后的区块中选择了大约均匀的偏差层,以提供跨发电机深度的直接辅助监督,同时排除其特征可能尚不足够翔实的最早区块.
计算方面的制约因素阻碍了对这些来源层次选择战略的系统比较,我们可以在今后的推广工作中重新审视。

blocks.en:
For auxiliary initialization, the 1.3B configuration follows the early variant using source features from layer 15, with blocks 17–19 used to initialize the auxiliary predictor.
For the 5B model, we instead initialize from the final backbone blocks, decoupling this choice from the source-layer configuration and simplifying subsequent scale-up.
These blocks are also closer to the output and are chosen to better match the output head, which is likewise initialized from the original generator.
Preliminary experiments suggest that this initialization strategy may offer a modest improvement in early-stage convergence.
blocks.zh:
对于辅助初始化,1.3B配置遵循早期变体,使用第15层的源特性,区块17–19用于初始化辅助预测器.
对于5B模型,我们转而从最后的骨干块初始化,将这一选择与源层配置脱钩,并简化之后的扩展.
这些块也更接近输出,被选择来更好地匹配输出头,同样从原始生成器初始化.
初步实验表明,这种初始化战略可能在早期趋同方面略有改进。

blocks.en: A.2 Training Configurations
blocks.zh: A.2 培训配置

blocks.en:
We use Wan2.1-1.3B for early-stage exploration and controlled ablation studies.
Training runs for 20,000 steps on eight GPUs using 85-frame clips at a resolution of 768 × 432 768\times 432 and 16 FPS, with a per-GPU batch size of one and a global batch size of eight.
We use AdamW with ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0 , 0.999 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0,0.999) , a weight decay of 0.01, and a gradient clipping threshold of 0.1.
The generator and auxiliary branches share the same learning rate, which is linearly warmed up to 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} over the first 1,000 steps and held constant thereafter.
Both use uniformly sampled flow times followed by a timestep shift of 5.0.
We assign a weight of 1 to the main teacher-forcing loss and set w Δ = 0.5 w_{\Delta}=0.5 for every future offset in equation 7 .
During training, we replace the text prompt with an empty string with a probability of 0.1.
We maintain an exponential moving average of the generator parameters with a decay rate of 0.9995, starting at step 2,000, and use the EMA weights corresponding to each evaluated training step.
All 1.3B ablation experiments follow these training settings.
Unless otherwise specified, the 5B experiments follow the same training settings as the 1.3B model.
blocks.zh:
我们使用Wan2.1-1.3B进行早期探索和控制性萎缩研究.
训练在8个GPU上运行20000步,使用85帧的剪辑,分辨率为768×432 768\times 432和16 FPS,每GPU批量尺寸为1个,全球批量尺寸为8个.
我们使用 AdamW 的 (β 1, β 2) = (0, 0.999) (\β 1}, \β 2}) = (0, 0.999), 重量衰减 0.01, 梯度剪切阈值为 0.1 。
生成器和辅助分支的学习率相同,在最初的1000个步骤中,其线性热度可达1×10−5 1\Times 10×5],并在之后保持不变.
两者均使用统一抽样的流量时间,然后时间步移5.0.
我们给主课老师损失分配了1的权重,
在训练期间,我们将文本提示替换为空字符串,概率为0.1.
我们维持发电机参数的指数移动平均值,衰变率为0.9995,从第2000步开始,并使用每个评估的培训步骤对应的EMA权重。
所有1.3B消毒实验都遵循这些训练环境.
除非另有说明,5B实验遵循与1.3B模型相同的训练环境.

blocks.en:
The first stage runs for 25,000 steps on 32 GPUs using 121-frame clips at a resolution of 1024 × 576 1024\times 576 and 24 FPS, with a per-GPU batch size of one and a global batch size of 32.
All other training settings follow the 1.3B configuration.
blocks.zh:
第一阶段在32台GPU上运行25 000步,使用121帧剪辑,分辨率为1024×576 1024\times 576和24 FPS,每台GPU批量尺寸为1,全球批量尺寸为32.
所有其他训练设置都遵循1.3B配置.

blocks.en: A.3 Evaluation Settings
blocks.zh: A.3 评价设置

blocks.en:
We use UniPC with 50 denoising steps per chunk, a classifier-free guidance scale of 3.0, and a timestep shift of 5.0 for all models.
Sampling uses the corresponding EMA weights, with all FCP-specific modules removed.
When the inference sequence exceeds the training sequence length, we retain the first three latent frames as attention sinks during KV-cache eviction.
blocks.zh:
我们使用UniPC,每个块有50个调试步骤,无分类器的制导尺度为3.0,所有模型的时序位移为5.0.
抽样使用相应的EMA权重,所有FCP专用模块都被移除.
当推断序列超过训练序列长度时,我们保留了前三个潜在框架,作为KV-cache驱逐过程中的注意力吸收.

blocks.en:
We evaluate both image-to-video and video-to-video generation.
For I2V, we condition on the benchmark-provided initial image.
For V2V, we use the longest suffix of the three-second conditioning video compatible with the model’s latent and chunk-length constraints.
Both settings generate five-second continuations, and evaluation excludes the conditioning video.
Our models use 16:9 resolutions and require no spatial cropping.
blocks.zh:
我们评价图像到视频和视频到视频的生成。
对于I2V,我们以基准提供的初始图像为条件.
对于V2V,我们使用与模型潜在和块长限制兼容的三秒调制视频中最长的后缀.
这两个设置产生5秒的续作,评价排除了调制视频.
我们的模型使用16:9分辨率,不需要空间裁剪。

blocks.en:
Unless otherwise specified, we use best-practice prompts (BPP) and evaluate all 198 benchmark samples using the official Physics-IQ Verified implementation without modifying its metrics.
Evaluation uses each model’s output frame rate specified in Section A.2 , with reference videos at the corresponding frame rate.
We perform four independent runs with seeds 42–45, compute benchmark scores separately for each run, and report their mean.
blocks.zh:
除非另有说明,否则我们使用最佳做法提示(BPP),并使用正式的物理-IQ验证执行来评价所有198个基准样本,而不修改其衡量标准。
评价采用A.2节规定的每个模型的输出帧率,参考视频按相应的帧率播放.
我们用42至45个种子进行四次独立运行,为每次运行分别计算基准分数,并报告其平均值。

blocks.en:
We evaluate the teacher-forced and FCP-trained Wan2.2 5B models on all samples of WorldModelBench, PAI-Bench-G, and PhyGround in the I2V setting, using otherwise identical training settings.
We use the benchmark-provided initial images and text prompts, resize images while preserving their aspect ratio, and crop them to the 1024 × 576 1024\times 576 target resolution when needed.
All three evaluations generate five-second videos at 24 FPS.
For each benchmark, we use its official evaluation code and unmodified metrics, compute scores separately for seeds 42–45, and report their mean in Table 3 .
blocks.zh:
我们利用原本相同的培训环境,对I2V环境中WorldModel Bench、PAI-Bench-G和PhyGround的所有样本进行教师强化和FCP培训的Wan2.2 5B模型的评估。
我们使用基准提供的初始图像和文本提示,在保持图像的外观比例的同时调整图像大小,并在需要时将其剪切为1024×576 1024\times 576目标分辨率.
所有三项评价都生成了FPS24的五秒视频.
对于每个基准,我们使用其官方评价代码和未经修改的衡量标准,分别计算42-45种子的得分,并在表3中报告其平均值。

blocks.en: A.5 Representation Visualization Protocol
blocks.zh: A.5 可见性议定书

blocks.en:
We use the final 20,000-step EMA checkpoints of the teacher-forced and FCP-trained Wan2.1-1.3B models to visualize their representations on real videos.
Both models receive the same clean video latents, and we extract intermediate features from a single selected source layer of the main generator for each comparison.
The layer and manually selected query-token position are matched between the two models, with the query vector extracted separately from each model’s features.
We compute cosine similarity between the query and other tokens in the same frame for spatial maps; for temporal maps, a query from one frame is compared with tokens across the remaining frames.
Similarity values are displayed directly on the token grid without spatial interpolation.
Within each comparison, the teacher-forced and FCP maps use the same color map and a shared value range determined from that comparison’s similarity values.

我们使用教师强迫和FCP训练的Wan2.1-1.3B模式的2万步EMA最后检查站,
两种模型都接收到同样干净的视频潜质,我们从主生成器的单个选定源层中提取中间特征,用于每次比较.

blocks.en: A.6 Auxiliary Prediction Visualization Protocol
blocks.zh: A.6 辅助预测可视化议定书

blocks.en:
For Figure 11 , we use the final 25,000-step EMA checkpoint of our Wan2.2-5B FCP model and visualize predictions on real videos.
The main generator processes clean ground-truth history with its corresponding text prompt, and we extract the hidden states 𝐡 k \mathbf{h}_{k} of the final source chunk.
Conditioned on 𝐡 k \mathbf{h}_{k} , each offset-specific auxiliary branch independently samples a future chunk from random noise using the same UniPC settings as standard inference: 50 denoising steps, a classifier-free guidance scale of 3.0, and a timestep shift of 5.0.
The branches receive neither intervening ground-truth or generated chunks nor a separate text input.
For display, we sample decoded frames uniformly and align them temporally with the ground-truth frames.
The auxiliary branches are retained only for this analysis and are otherwise removed during standard inference.
blocks.zh:
对于图11,我们使用我们Wan2.2-5B FCP模型的最后25000步EMA检查点,并在真实视频中可视化预测.
主生成器以相应的文本提示处理干净的地面真实历史, 我们提取最后源块的隐藏状态 h k\ mathbf{ h}_{k} 。
以 h k\ mathbf{h}_{k} 为条件,每个偏移特定的辅助分支使用与标准推论相同的UniPC设置,独立地对随机噪声的未来块进行样本:50除噪步骤,3.0的无分级制导尺度,5.0的时序位移.
分支既不接收干扰的地面事实,也不生成块块,也不单独输入文字。
为了展示,我们用统一样本来解码帧,并将其与地面真实帧同步。
辅助分支只保留用于这种分析,否则在标准推论中被移除.

blocks.en: B.2 Feature Conditioning
blocks.zh: B.2 特点

blocks.en:
Table 7 compares different strategies for injecting source features into the auxiliary predictors.
Concatenating source features along the channel dimension followed by linear fusion is a common and straightforward implementation.
Even with this simple design, FCP improves the IQ score from 27.6 to 29.5 over teacher forcing.
Motivated by prior work demonstrating the effectiveness of AdaLN for feature injection ( Wang et al., 2026b ; Pan et al., 2026 ) , we apply token-wise AdaLN throughout the auxiliary DiT blocks, further increasing the IQ score to 30.9.
We hypothesize that this improvement arises from its layer-wise modulation and learned scaling factors, which provide fine-grained conditioning pathways and strengthen gradient propagation through the source representations into the generator.
Notably, directly concatenating source and future tokens within self-attention is less effective, reaching an IQ score of 28.8.
We hypothesize that joint self-attention weakens the fine-grained correspondence between source and future representations.
blocks.zh:
表7比较了在辅助预测器中注入源特征的不同策略。
沿通道维度的凝聚源特征,然后是线性聚变,是一种常见的和直截了当的实施.
即便有了这种简单的设计,FCP还是将智商分数从27.6分提高到29.5分,而不是教师强迫.
由于先前的工作证明AdaLN在特征注射方面的有效性(Wang等人,2026年b;Pan等人,2026年b),我们在整个辅助DiT区块采用象征性的AdaLN,进一步将IQ分数提高到30.9。
我们假设,这种改进产生于其分层调节和学习的缩放因子,这些因子提供了精细的调节路径,并通过源表示法加强梯度传播到生成器中。
值得注意的是,在自觉内直接调适源和未来的代币效果较差,达到智商比分28.8.
我们假设共同的自我观察会削弱来源与未来表述之间的细微对应关系。

blocks.en: Appendix C Limitations and Discussions
blocks.zh: 附录C 限制和讨论

blocks.en: C.1 Comparison with Next Forcing
blocks.zh: C.1 与下一个附加条件的比较

blocks.en:
As discussed in Section 2.2 , Next Forcing ( Xu et al., 2026 ) explores a closely related future-prediction idea.
Importantly, our work was developed independently of and concurrently with Next Forcing ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . The initial FCP prototype design was completed before the Next Forcing paper became publicly available. While both works explore future prediction for autoregressive video generation, we target different tasks and adopt distinct methodological and experimental designs. First, Next Forcing is primarily framed around world-action modeling and robotic action learning, whereas we focus on autoregressive video generation as a pathway toward generative world modeling.
blocks.zh:
如第2.2节所述,下一个强制措施 (徐等人,2026年) 探索一个密切相关的未来预测思想.
重要的是,我们的工作是在Next Forcing(徐等人,2026年)之外并同时进行的。 最初的FCP原型设计是在"下一堡"纸公开发行前完成的. 虽然这两部作品都探索了未来对自递录视频生成的预测,但我们针对不同的任务,采用不同的方法和实验设计. 首先,"下一步"主要围绕着世界行动模型和机器人动作学习,而我们则侧重于自旋式视频生成,作为实现基因世界模型的路径.

blocks.en: Second, Next Forcing conditions its auxiliary predictors on the full visible history 𝐡 ≤ k \mathbf{h}_{\leq k} , whereas ours use only 𝐡 k \mathbf{h}_{k} . As discussed in Section 4.1 , this choice encourages the source-chunk representation itself to compactly encode information predictive of future evolution. Beyond this design rationale, we test the context choice with a full-context FCP variant shown in Figure 4 . At matched training steps, the two FCP variants achieve comparable IQ scores, but ours requires roughly 40–50% less training compute to attain the same performance. Our source-chunk-only design thus offers a more efficient and scalable form of future-prediction supervision, an important consideration when training larger video generators.
blocks.zh: 第二,在全可见历史 h \ k\ mathbf{ h}_{\leq k} 上附加附加条件, 而我们的仅使用 h k\ mathbf{ h}_{k} 。 正如第4.1节所讨论的那样,这一选择鼓励源头表示本身对预测未来演变的信息进行紧凑编码。 除了这一设计原理外,我们还用图4所示的全文FCP变体测试上下文选择。 在相应的培训步骤上,两个FCP变体取得了类似的智商分数,但我们的分数需要大约40-50%的训练计算才能达到同样的成绩。 因此,我们只有源头的设计提供了更有效和可扩展的未来预测监督形式,在培训大型视频发电机时是一个重要考虑因素。

blocks.en: Third, Next Forcing adopts a chained prediction architecture inspired by language-model MTP ( DeepSeek-AI, 2024 ) , whereas our offset-specific predictors operate in parallel from 𝐡 k \mathbf{h}_{k} . Unlike discrete-token prediction, diffusion-based video prediction gives each auxiliary predictor a partially noised future latent. Chaining may therefore pass information from an intermediate future chunk to later predictors along the red path in Figure 2(a) , weakening the intended predictive supervision on 𝐡 k \mathbf{h}_{k} .
blocks.zh: 第三,Next Forcing采用了由语言模型MTP(DeepSeek-AI, 2024)启发的链式预测架构,而我们的抵消特定预测器则在 h k\mathbf{h}_{k}平行运行. 与离散式触控预测不同,基于扩散的视频预测给每个辅助预测器带来部分点名的未来潜伏. 因此,链路可能将信息从中间未来块传递到图2(a)中红色路径的后期预测器,削弱h k\mathbf{h}_{k}的预定预测监督。

blocks.en:
Consistent with this concern, the chained variant retains a gain at 1.3B with three offsets, but offers only a marginal I2V gain and no V2V gain at 5B models. This decline suggests that information leakage in chained prediction may become more consequential at larger model scales, as higher-capacity models can more readily exploit intermediate future information and thereby weaken the intended supervision.
Parallel prediction, by contrast, remains effective in both settings (Tables 4 and 2 ), supporting its use for visual future prediction.
blocks.zh:
与这种担忧相一致的是,链式变体保留了1.3B的增益,并有3个抵消,但仅提供边际I2V增益,5B型号则没有V2V增益. 这一下降表明,链式预测中的信息泄漏在更大的模型尺度上可能变得更加严重,因为高容量模型可以更容易地利用中期未来信息,从而削弱预期的监督。
相比之下,平行预测在两种场合都依然有效(表4和表2),支持其用于视觉未来预测.

blocks.en:
Our different task emphasis also shapes several design and evaluation choices.
We supervise both clean-context and noisy-target representations, and use token-wise AdaLN to inject source features into the auxiliary predictors, drawing on prior experience in visual generation ( Wang et al., 2026b ; Pan et al., 2026 ) .
Our evaluation focuses on the physical plausibility of generated videos, reflecting our interest in visual evolution rather than action-planning performance.
blocks.zh:
我们不同的任务重点也决定了一些设计和评价选择。
我们监督干净的文字和响亮的目标表示,并利用象征性的AdaLN在辅助预测器中注入源特征,借鉴以往的视觉生成经验(Wang等人,2026b;Pan等人,2026年)。
我们的评价侧重于生成的视频的物理可信度,反映了我们对视觉进化的兴趣,而不是行动规划的表现.

blocks.en: C.2 Potential Inference-Time Applications
blocks.zh: C.2 可能的推断时间应用

blocks.en:
Figure 11 suggests that the auxiliary predictors can anticipate future dynamics, although their outputs do not yet reach the visual fidelity expected of final video generation.
Replacing the main generator with these branches throughout denoising may therefore compromise output quality.
One possibility is to use them during early, high-noise denoising before handing the sample to the main generator for refinement, potentially reducing sampling cost.
Alternatively, combining their predictions with those of the main generator may improve the reliability of the resulting future evolution.
These inference-time applications remain untested and are left for future work.
blocks.zh:
图11显示,辅助预测器可以预测未来的动态,尽管其产出尚未达到最终视频生成的预期视觉忠诚度.
因此,将主要发电机更换成这些分支,可能会损害产出质量。
一种可能性是,在将样品交给主要发电机加以改进之前,在早期高噪音时使用,从而有可能降低取样费用。
或者,将它们的预测与主要发电机的预测结合起来,可以提高由此产生的未来演变的可靠性。
这些推断时间的应用仍未经过测试,留待未来工作。

blocks.en: C.3 From-Scratch Pretraining and Further Scaling
blocks.zh: C.3 退缩培训和进一步扩大

blocks.en:
Due to computational constraints, our experiments do not cover larger model scales or training on substantially longer videos.
We therefore leave broader scaling and evaluation across longer temporal horizons to future work.
blocks.zh:
由于计算上的局限,我们的实验不包括更大的模型尺度或对更长视频的培训。
因此,我们将更广阔的时间范围的规模和评价留给今后的工作。

blocks.en:
All current models are initialized from pretrained bidirectional video diffusion checkpoints rather than pretrained from scratch.
In our experiments, adapting these checkpoints for autoregressive training led to early-stage performance degradation.
We suspect that bidirectional and autoregressive models may organize their representations differently, so this initialization could limit the extent to which FCP’s benefits emerge.
We aim to investigate large-scale from-scratch pretraining with FCP as a native objective for autoregressive world models, together with more diverse, higher-quality data tailored to this setting.
blocks.zh:
目前的所有模式都从预先训练的双向视频传播检查站开始,而不是从头开始训练。
在我们的实验中,调整这些检查站进行自发性训练,导致早期性能退化。
我们怀疑双向模式和自递模式可能会以不同的方式组织其表述,因此这种初始化会限制FCP的效益产生的程度.
我们的目标是调查与FCP一起进行大规模脱壳预训的情况,将其作为自递式世界模型的本土目标,同时研究适合这种环境的更多样化、更高质量的数据。
